priority.summary: Fermi Inc. announced that its subsidiaries entered into a Limited Waiver and Amendment No. 1 to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd., eliminating a covenant that required the company to enter into a lease or offtake arrangement for 400 MW on the Project Matador site by November 10, 2026. The company paid amendment fees totaling $25 million in connection with the agreement.
